{{Quote|Beware the ancient protectors, Mara. They are unkind to trespassers.|Kyle Katarn, to Mara Jade before she entered the Catacombs|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
'''Sith undead''', long-dead [[Sith|Sith]] warriors,<ref name="Feat">{{LucasArts|url=products/sith/sith_features.htm|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith - Features}}</ref> lay dormant in the [[Dark Force Temple]] Catacombs on the [[Planet|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Ghastly [[Color|white]] in appearance, they wore black burial robes with a red cloth around the waist. Their armor consisted of grey shoulder [[Pauldron|pauldrons]], brown studded wristbands, a brown stomach plate, red knee-pads, and black boots. Powered by the Temple's [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] [[Vergence|Force nexus]],<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref> their red eyes opened as the undead reanimated to attack intruders by channeling [[Force lightning|Force lightning]] through their hands.<ref name="MOTS" /> 

In [[10 ABY|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY|5 ABY]]. Therefore, we can deduce that ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY|10 ABY]].</ref> [[Jedi|Jedi]]-[[Reciprocal apprenticeship|in-training]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] encountered the [[Zombie|zombies]] during her [[Mission to Dromund Kaas (New Republic)|quest to save]] her friend and co-learner [[Kyle Katarn]] from the Temple's dark pull.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|ZOMBIES!... And it's canon. Zombies are canon.|Ryan Kaufman|<ref name="blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|4|Kyle and Mara: Making Mysteries of the Sith - Part II: Zombies of the Dark Side}}</ref>}}
The enemy characters appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''. Unlike the [[Sith Jedi Statue|Sith Jedi statues]] also found guarding the Temple, the game's manual excluded the Sith undead from its character section,<ref name="MOTS" /> but they were described in the [[LucasArts]] pages for the game's FAQ,<ref name="FAQ">{{LucasArts|url=products/sith/sith_faq.htm|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith - FAQ}}</ref> Story,<ref name="Story">{{LucasArts|url=products/sith/sith_story.htm|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith - Story}}</ref> and Features.<ref name="Feat" />
